steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: empty canvas — starting from nothing
steps.detail: No modules yet. The next steps add each Listener / Processor / Router / Transport one at a time.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Poll Inbound 999 TA1 Files” (Listener · Directory / File)
steps.detail: Adds a Directory Listener — polls a folder for inbound files and starts a transaction for each match. Focus: Poll Inbound 999 TA1 Files.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Fork - XPath” (Processor · XPath)
steps.detail: Adds an XPath Fork — splits multi-transaction EDI XML so each ST (or Transaction node) flows independently. Focus: Fork - XPath.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Extract Ack Codes” (Processor · XPath Evaluation)
steps.detail: Adds XPath Evaluation — pulls key fields into transaction attributes for later routing and naming. Focus: Extract Ack Codes.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Debug Write Ack XML” (Processor · File Writing)
steps.detail: Adds a File Writing processor — debug/snapshot write so you can inspect the payload mid-route. Focus: Debug Write Ack XML.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Build Ack Decision XML” (Processor · XSLT Transformation)
steps.detail: Adds an XSLT Transformation — maps the current XML into the next document shape (decision, report, etc.). Focus: Build Ack Decision XML.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Debug Write Ack Decision” (Processor · File Writing)
steps.detail: Adds a File Writing processor — debug/snapshot write so you can inspect the payload mid-route. Focus: Debug Write Ack Decision.

steps.message: 1 - Intake And Classify: add “Stage Ack Decision” (Transport · Directory / File)
steps.detail: Adds a Directory Transport — writes the transaction payload out to a target folder (bucket / stage / archive). Focus: Stage Ack Decision.
